__PERSON_F__ Is Tested in the Wilderness
1 __PERSON_F__, full of the __SPIRIT_A__, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness, 2 where for forty days he was tempted[a] by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and at the end of them he was hungry.

3 The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of __MOST_HIGH_A__, tell this stone to become bread.”

1 __PERSON_F__ answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’[b]”

5 The devil led him up to a high place and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world. 6 And he said to him, “I will give you all their authority and splendor; it has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to. 7 If you worship me, it will all be yours.”

8 __PERSON_F__ answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the __MASTER_A__ your __MOST_HIGH_A__ and serve him only.’[c]”

9 The devil led him to __CITY_A__ and had him stand on the highest point of the __PLACE_A__. “If you are the Son of __MOST_HIGH_A__,” he said, “throw yourself down from here. 10 For it is written:

“‘He will command his angels concerning you
to guard you carefully;
11 they will lift you up in their hands,
so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’[d]”

12 __PERSON_F__ answered, “It is said: ‘Do not put the __MASTER_A__ your __MOST_HIGH_A__ to the test.’[e]”

13 When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.

__PERSON_F__ Rejected at __VILLAGE_A__
14 __PERSON_F__ returned to __REGION_A__ in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside. 15 He was teaching in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.

16 He went to __VILLAGE_A__, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom. He stood up to read, 17 and the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. Unrolling it, he found the place where it is written:

18 “The Spirit of the __MASTER_A__ is on me,
because he has anointed me
to proclaim good news to the poor.
He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners
and recovery of sight for the blind,
to set the oppressed free,
19 to proclaim the year of the __MASTER_A__ favor.”[f]

20 Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him. 21 He began by saying to them, “Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”

22 All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. “Isn’t this __PERSON_E__ son?” they asked.

23 __PERSON_F__ said to them, “Surely you will quote this proverb to me: ‘Physician, heal yourself!’ And you will tell me, ‘Do here in your hometown what we have heard that you did in Capernaum.’”

24 “Truly I tell you,” he continued, “no prophet is accepted in his hometown. 25 I assure you that there were many widows in __PEOPLE_A__ in __PROPHET_A__ time, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and there was a severe famine throughout the land. 26 Yet __PROPHET_A__ was not sent to any of them, but to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon. 27 And there were many in __PEOPLE_A__ with leprosy[g] in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”

28 All the people in the synagogue were furious when they heard this. 29 They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him off the cliff. 30 But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.

__PERSON_F__ Drives Out an Impure Spirit
31 Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in __REGION_A__, and on the Sabbath he taught the people. 32 They were amazed at his teaching, because his words had authority.

33 In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an impure spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice, 34 “Go away! What do you want with us, __PERSON_F__ of __VILLAGE_A__? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of __MOST_HIGH_A__!”

35 “Be quiet!” __PERSON_F__ said sternly. “Come out of him!” Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.

36 All the people were amazed and said to each other, “What words these are! With authority and power he gives orders to impure spirits and they come out!” 37 And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.

__PERSON_F__ Heals Many
38 __PERSON_F__ left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked __PERSON_F__ to help her. 39 So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.

40 At sunset, the people brought to __PERSON_F__ all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them. 41 Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of __MOST_HIGH_A__!” But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.

42 At daybreak, __PERSON_F__ went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them. 43 But he said, “I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__ to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent.” 44 And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.
translations:
__PERSON_F__ 在旷野受试探  
1 __PERSON_F__ 满有 __SPIRIT_A__ 的灵，从约旦出来，被圣灵引到旷野，2 在那里四十天被魔鬼试探。他这几天一点都没吃，最后他饿了。

3 魔鬼对他说：“你若是 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的儿子，就吩咐这块石头变成食物吧。”

4 __PERSON_F__ 回答说：“经上记着：‘人活着，不是单靠食物。’”

5 魔鬼带他上高处，一下子把世上的万国都指给他看。6 他对他说：“我将这权势和荣耀都给你，因为都是交给我了，我想赐给谁就赐给谁。7 你若敬拜我，这一切都归你。”

8 __PERSON_F__ 回应说：“经上记着：‘当敬拜 __MASTER_A__ 你的 __MOST_HIGH_A__，单要事奉他。’”

9 魔鬼又带他到 __CITY_A__ ，叫他站在 __PLACE_A__ 的最高处，说：“你若是 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的儿子，就跳下去吧。10 因为经上说：

11 “‘他要为你吩咐他的使者，保护你，  
他们要用手托着你，  
免得你的脚碰在石头上。’”

12 __PERSON_F__ 回答说：“经上又说：‘不可试探 __MASTER_A__ 你的 __MOST_HIGH_A__。’”

13 魔鬼试探完了，就离开他，等候时机。

__PERSON_F__ 在 __VILLAGE_A__ 被拒绝  
14 __PERSON_F__ 以圣灵的能力回到 __REGION_A__ ，他的消息传遍全乡。15 他在会堂里教导众人，众人都称赞他。

16 他来到养育他的 __VILLAGE_A__ ，照着安息日的规矩进会堂，17 站起来念，经长递给他以赛亚先知的书卷，他展开找到写着：

18 “__MASTER_A__ 的灵在我身上，  
因为他膏我，  
叫我向贫穷人传好信息，  
差遣我报告被囚的得释放，  
瞎眼的得看见，  
使受压制的得自由，  
19 宣告 __MASTER_A__ 喜悦的禧年。”

20 他把书卷卷起，交给执事，坐下，会堂众人的目光都注视他。21 他开口对他们说：“今天这经应验在你们耳中了。”

22 众人都称赞他，惊奇他所讲的恩言，说：“这不就是 __PERSON_E__ 的儿子吗？”

23 __PERSON_F__ 对他们说：“你们必定把这句话用在我身上说：‘医生啊，医治你自己吧！’又说：‘我们在迦百农所听见你作的事，也在你家乡做吧！’”

24 他说：“我实在告诉你们，先知在自己的家乡通常不得欢迎。25 我指着你们保证，在 __PROPHET_A__ 的时候，天闭塞了三年半，遍地饥荒，那时在 __PEOPLE_A__ 有许多寡妇，26 但神没差派先知去他们那里，只差派他去西顿地区撒勒法的一位寡妇那里。27 在以利沙先知的时候， __PEOPLE_A__ 有许多痲疯病人，却没有一个得洁净的，只有叙利亚人乃缦。”

28 会堂里的人听了这话就满心恼怒。29 他们起来，把他赶出城，领到城外的山岗上，要把他推下山崖。30 但他从人群中穿过，自行离去。

__PERSON_F__ 驱除污灵  
31 他下迦百农城，在安息日教导众人。32 众人听他讲道，因他的话有权威，感到诧异。

33 会堂里有一个人被污鬼附着，发出喊叫声，34 “退去！你找我们有什么事， __VILLAGE_A__ 的 __PERSON_F__？你来毁灭我们吗？我知道你是谁—— __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的圣者！”

35 __PERSON_F__ 斥责说：“闭嘴！出来！”鬼就使那人摔倒在众人面前，出来了，却没有伤害他。

36 众人都惊讶，彼此说：“这话真奇怪！他用权威和能力吩咐污鬼，污鬼便出来了！”37 关于他的名声在四周传开。

__PERSON_F__ 治好许多人  
38 __PERSON_F__ 离开会堂，去西门家。西门的婆婆发高烧，他们求 __PERSON_F__ 帮助她。39 他俯身斥责发烧，病就退了，她立刻起来服侍他们。

40 日落时分，人们把各样有病之人带到 __PERSON_F__ 面前，他按手治好他们。41 诸多鬼也从许多人身上出来，喊着“你是 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的儿子！”但他斥责他们，不许他们说话，因为他们知道他是弥赛亚。

42 天刚亮， __PERSON_F__ 退到旷野去。人们寻找他，来到他所在之地，想阻止他离开。43 他对他们说：“我必须向别的城镇也宣讲 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 国的福音，因为我就是为这事被差遣。”44 他就在犹太的会堂里不断传道。
